tools.description: Normalize an HTTP/HTTPS URL, remove only its fragment and generate an escaped canonical link tag locally.

tools.name: HTML Entity Reference
tools.description: Look up an HTML entity, Unicode character or code point and return its character, named and numeric forms locally.

tools.name: HTTP Header Reference
tools.description: Look up a header's canonical name, category, purpose and typical example in a local curated reference.

tools.name: HTTP Status Code Lookup
tools.description: Look up an HTTP status code's standard text, category and concise description from a local reference.

tools.name: Meta Tag Generator
tools.description: Generate safely escaped title and description, author, robots and theme-color markup as inert text.
tools.cliExample: codestation run meta-tag-generator --options '{"title":"Code Station","description":"Local developer toolbox","url":"https://codestation.in"}'

tools.name: MIME Type Lookup
tools.description: Map a file extension or MIME type to its MIME type, common extensions and media category locally.

tools.name: Open Graph Generator
tools.description: Generate escaped Open Graph tags from supplied metadata without fetching a page or image.
tools.cliExample: codestation run open-graph-generator --options '{"title":"Code Station","description":"Local developer toolbox","url":"https://codestation.in"}'

tools.name: Open Graph Preview
tools.description: Preview only the social metadata you enter locally, without visiting its URL or promising exact platform rendering.
tools.cliExample: codestation run open-graph-preview --options '{"title":"Code Station","description":"Local developer toolbox","url":"https://codestation.in"}'

tools.name: Query String Generator
tools.description: Encode structured query entries, preserving their order, repeated keys and empty values.

tools.name: Query String Parser
tools.description: Decode a query string or URL into ordered key/value entries and a parameter count locally.

tools.name: Robots.txt Generator
tools.description: Generate robots.txt from explicit user-agent groups, allow/disallow paths and sitemap URLs without crawling.

tools.name: Sitemap XML Generator
tools.description: Generate escaped sitemap XML from URL entries and only the optional dates, frequencies and priorities you supply.

tools.name: Twitter/X Card Generator
tools.description: Generate safely escaped Twitter/X card metadata as text from supplied content and optional handles.
tools.cliExample: codestation run twitter-card-generator --options '{"cardType":"summary_large_image","title":"Code Station","description":"Local developer toolbox"}'

tools.name: URL Builder
tools.description: Build an HTTP or HTTPS URL from explicit components and ordered query rows without visiting it.

tools.name: URL Encoding Inspector
tools.description: Inspect percent-encoded runs, decoded values and their positions, and show a fully decoded preview locally.

tools.name: URL Fragment Parser
tools.description: Extract the raw and decoded fragment from a URL or #fragment without navigating to it.

tools.name: URL Parser
tools.description: Break a URL into its protocol, credentials presence, hostname, path, ordered query parameters and fragment without visiting it.

tools.name: URL Path Analyzer
tools.description: Inspect a URL or pathname's segments, count, final filename and extension locally without a request.

tools.name: User-Agent Parser
tools.description: Heuristically parse a supplied User-Agent string into browser, OS, device type and engine without fingerprinting.

tools.name: Web App Manifest Generator
tools.description: Generate formatted Web App Manifest JSON from explicit app settings and icon metadata without fetching icons.

tools.name: AES-GCM Encrypt & Decrypt
tools.description: AES-GCM Encrypt & Decrypt: operation mode, key mode, key length, plaintext or encrypted payload, passphrase, raw secret key (hex or base64), initialization vector (12-byte hex, optional), additional authenticated data (aad, optional) → ciphertext (base64), ciphertext (hex), authentication tag (128-bit), initialization vector (iv / nonce), json bundle format, decrypted plaintext. Process locally in your browser.

tools.name: CSP (Content Security Policy) Builder
tools.description: CSP (Content Security Policy) Builder: default-src, script-src, style-src, img-src, connect-src, font-src, object-src, frame-ancestors, base-uri → http header string, security audit score & grade, actionable risk warnings, html meta tag equivalent, nginx configuration directive, next.js headers configuration. Process locally in your browser.

tools.name: CSR (Certificate Signing Request) Inspector
tools.description: CSR (Certificate Signing Request) Inspector: pkcs#10 pem or base64 der → subject distinguished name (dn), subject alternative names (sans), public key algorithm & modulus, cryptographic self-signature validity, parsed asn.1 structure. Process locally in your browser.

tools.name: JWT Signer & Verifier
tools.description: JWT Signer & Verifier: operation mode, algorithm, header (json), payload (json), compact jwt token, secret key (or rsa private key pem), rsa public key pem (for rs256 verification) → compact jwt token, cryptographic signature validity, decoded header json, decoded payload json, claims validation (exp, nbf, clock skew). Process locally in your browser.

tools.name: RSA Key Pair Generator
tools.description: RSA Key Pair Generator: key size → pkcs#8 private key pem, spki public key pem, sha-256 public key fingerprint, key metadata (modulus & exponent). Process locally in your browser.
